meta_description:
1,187 likes, 92 comments - attagalatta on December 6, 2022: "This Bangalore Girl not only won hearts on screen, but in the literary world too. With over 50% of votes in the bag, Kubbra Sait’s ‘Open Book – Not quite a memoir’ won the AG-BLF Book Prize in the Popular Choice category.
This book is Kubbra’s first attempt at being an author and she has left all of us wanting more of Kukkoo Ka Magic.
Congratulations!
We can’t wait to know what’s coming next from your pen.


#AttaGalatta #AGxBLF #AGBLFBookPrize #OpenBook #PopularChoiceAward".
